categories.main_business_segments: BH Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: the Flexible Printed Circuit Board (FPCB) manufacturing and sales segment, and the automotive electronics segment focused on vehicle wireless phone chargers. The FPCB segment serves advanced IT industries with products for smartphones, 5G antennas, and EV battery cables. The automotive electronics segment was expanded through acquisition in 2022 and focuses on in-vehicle wireless charging solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced FPCB technologies including build-up and RF type FPCBs, employing patented manufacturing methods such as partial copper plating, hole filling, and fine patterning techniques. It uses high-precision processes like laser build-up multi-layer fabrication and has developed proprietary methods for coverlay lamination and embedded circuit boards. The automotive segment leverages wireless power consortium (WPC) standards for high-power wireless charging products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: BH serves major global IT device manufacturers, including smartphone, OLED, LCD module, 5G antenna, battery, and automotive electronics companies. Key customers include Samsung Display and other leading electronics firms. The primary markets are consumer electronics, telecommunications, electric vehicles, and automotive components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in South Korea (Incheon), Vietnam (Binh Duong), and China (Shandong). Its sales and exports target global markets, with significant export sales to North America and China, serving multinational IT and automotive companies. The company is listed on the Korean stock exchange and maintains a global supply chain footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: BH operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of core components—flexible printed circuit boards and automotive wireless charging modules—that are supplied to OEMs and set makers in the IT and automotive industries. It sources raw materials like copper clad laminates and coverlay films from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in advanced FPCB manufacturing technologies such as fine patterning, multi-layer build-up, and embedded circuit boards to meet evolving customer demands for miniaturization and high functionality. It is expanding into automotive electronics and battery-related components, focusing on product innovation and market diversification. R&D investments are sustained at around 5-7% of sales, targeting product quality, process efficiency, and new application development.
categories.revenue_model: BH generates revenue primarily through product sales of FPCBs and automotive wireless charging devices. The majority of sales are export-driven, with direct sales to major global customers. The company does not rely on licensing or subscription models but focuses on manufacturing and selling high-value electronic components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BH competes globally with major FPCB manufacturers such as Nippon Mektron, Sumitomo, Fujikura (Japan), Interflex, Young Poong, SI-Flex (Korea), and ZDT, Flexium, Career (Taiwan). It holds a competitive position as one of the few Korean firms with full-process production lines in Vietnam, enabling cost advantages. BH is recognized for its advanced RF PCB production capabilities and strong partnerships with leading electronics firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, BH reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.59 trillion KRW with an operating profit margin of about 5.3%. The company has shown growth in sales over recent years, though 2023 sales slightly declined compared to 2022. Total assets exceed 1 trillion KRW, with equity around 650 billion KRW. External financing increased significantly in 2023 to support operations and investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BH differentiates itself through advanced manufacturing technologies enabling high-density, fine-pitch, and multi-layer FPCBs critical for cutting-edge IT and automotive applications. Its strategic production footprint in Vietnam reduces costs, while its strong R&D capabilities and patented processes ensure high product quality and reliability. The company’s automotive wireless charging products leverage global standards and maintain a strong market position, supporting customer trust and long-term partnerships.
